title: General Manager
description:
**General Manager (GM) \- FMCG Sales** 




 Location : Arookutty
 



 Experience : 10 plus years
 



 Salary : 18 LPA max
 



  





 Qualification: Graduation in any discipline (MBA preferred). Excellent communication
 



 skills in English (spoken and written).
 



  





 Experience: Minimum 10\+ years of experience in B2B Sales \& Business Development.
 



 Experience in food ingredients, seasoning, Spices, Flavors, related industries preferred.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve company targets.
 



  Lead and manage the sales team across regions.
 



  Identify new business opportunities and key customers.
 



  Build strong relationships with distributors, dealers, and clients.
 



  Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements.
 



  Prepare sales forecasts, budgets, and business plans.
 



  Coordinate with production, procurement, and management teams.
 



  Ensure achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
 



  Conduct client meetings, negotiations, and business presentations.
 



  Train and motivate the sales team for better performance.
 



**Required Skills:** 




  Strong leadership and team management abilities.
 



  Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
 



  Fluency in English is mandatory.
 



  Good knowledge of MS Office and reporting systems.
 



  Ability to travel for business development activities.
